notes: A Metromoney card costs 2 GEL (metro, bus and cable car rides 1 GEL). Bolt taxis are cheap. Take airport bus 337. For Kazbegi and Kakheti, book a tour (Gamarjoba, Budget Georgia, about 80-100 GEL) or use a marshrutka.
Winter is 0-5°C with snow; you can ski in Gudauri, and in snow you reach Gergeti by 4x4. April-May and September-October are ideal; the Kakheti grape harvest is in October.

Turkish citizens enter with an ID card (1 year visa-free). Carry cash in GEL (ATMs available); cards are widely accepted. Khinkali costs 1 GEL each, khachapuri 12-18 GEL, a glass of wine 8 GEL and a bath 50-100 GEL. Tip 10%.
Call ahead to book a private bath room (Chreli Abano). Haggle for a Gergeti 4x4 in town. Sighnaghi is full at weekends.
Georgian feasts are called supra, led by a tamada (toastmaster). "Gaumarjos" means cheers. Hold khinkali by the top, sip the broth and leave the top.
Kvevri amber wine (UNESCO), chacha (grape brandy), churchkhela, tkemali plum sauce and pkhali.

stops.name: Meidan & Sioni Katedrali
stops.tips: The heart of the old city: St Nino's hanging cross and Shardeni Street.

stops.name: Narikala Fortress Cable Car
stops.tips: Take the cable car from Rike Park (Metromoney card). You get a 4th-century fortress, the Mother of Georgia statue and views over the Kura.

stops.name: Abanotubani Sulphur Baths
stops.tips: Brick-domed 17th-century bathhouses where Pushkin is said to have bathed. A private room costs 50-100 GEL, scrub included. Orbeliani's facade is blue and looks like a mosque.

stops.name: Café Leila Old Town
stops.tips: Vegetarian Georgian food: try pkhali and lobio. On King Erekle Street.

stops.name: Bridge of Peace & Rike Park
stops.tips: A glass bridge lit up at night, over the Kura River.

backups.name: Shavi Lomi
backups.tips: A home-style restaurant full of art, serving modern Georgian food.

backups.name: Leghvtakhevi Waterfall
backups.tips: A waterfall behind the bath district. Free; a good alternative to a garden stroll.

stops.name: Rustaveli Avenue
stops.tips: Parliament, the Opera and the Rustaveli Theatre, in Soviet and Art Nouveau styles.

stops.name: Georgian National Museum
stops.tips: Colchis gold treasures and the Museum of Soviet Occupation, plus the Dmanisi skulls (1.8 million years old).

stops.name: Dry Bridge Market
stops.tips: A flea market selling Soviet medals, glass, kilims and paintings. Open daily, bigger at weekends.

stops.name: Barbarestan Khinkali
stops.tips: Recipes from a 19th-century cookbook. Book ahead; on Aghmashenebeli.

stops.name: Vino Underground Natural Wine
stops.tips: A bar for amber wine made in kvevri (clay vessels), an 8,000-year-old tradition. Tastings available.

backups.name: Fabrika Tbilisi
backups.tips: A hipster courtyard in a former Soviet sewing factory, with graffiti and cafes.

backups.name: Sofia Melnikova's Fantastic Douqan
backups.tips: In the garden of the Writers' House; try the khachapuri.

stops.name: Jvari Monastery
stops.tips: A 6th-century cross-shaped monastery above the meeting of the Aragvi and Kura, with Lermontov views. 30 minutes by taxi or marshrutka.

stops.name: Svetitskhoveli Cathedral
stops.tips: An 11th-century UNESCO cathedral with the legend of Christ's robe and royal tombs. Bring a headscarf.

stops.name: Salobie Bia Mtskheta
stops.tips: Lobio (bean stew) in a clay pot and mchadi cornbread: a Mtskheta classic.

stops.name: Samtavro Monastery
stops.tips: St Nino's blackberry bush and a community of nuns.

stops.name: Chronicle of Georgia Tbilisi
stops.tips: On the way back, Tsereteli's giant stone monument with views of the Tbilisi Sea.

backups.name: Shio-Mgvime Monastery
backups.tips: A 6th-century canyon monastery; an alternative to Samtavro.

backups.name: Chateau Mukhrani
backups.tips: Wine tasting and lunch in a princely chateau, 30 minutes from Mtskheta.

stops.name: Ananuri Fortress
stops.tips: On the Georgian Military Road (3 hours; tour about 80 GEL). A 17th-century fortress above the Zhinvali Reservoir.

stops.name: Gudauri Panorama Russia-Georgia Friendship Monument
stops.tips: A semicircle with Soviet mosaics at 2,400 m, with valley views and paragliding.

stops.name: Gergeti Trinity Church
stops.tips: A 14th-century church at 2,170 m facing Mount Kazbek (5,047 m). Go by 4x4 (60 GEL) or a 1.5-hour climb.

stops.name: Stepantsminda Lunch Khinkali
stops.tips: Mountain-style khinkali (Mtiuluri) in the town.

stops.name: Stepantsminda Kazbek View
stops.tips: The terrace of Rooms Hotel. The return takes 3 hours, with a stop in Pasanauri.

backups.name: Truso Valley
backups.tips: Ghost villages with mineral springs. An extra hike if you are not on a tour.

backups.name: Pasanauri Khinkali Stop
backups.tips: The town where khinkali was born; stop on the way back.

stops.name: Bodbe Monastery
stops.tips: 2 hours from Sighnaghi (tour about 100 GEL). St Nino's tomb, cypresses and the Alazani Valley.

stops.name: Sighnaghi
stops.tips: The walled "city of love" with Caucasus views, a 24-hour wedding registry and a Pirosmani museum.

stops.name: Pheasant's Tears Sighnaghi
stops.tips: Natural kvevri wines and lunch at John Wurdeman's winery. Tastings available.

stops.name: Kvareli Kindzmarauli Corporation
stops.tips: A kvevri wine producer with tastings of the semi-sweet red.

stops.name: Telavi & Alaverdi Monastery
stops.tips: Telavi's main town and the 11th-century Alaverdi Cathedral (50 m tall), then the drive back.

backups.name: Khareba Winery Tunnel
backups.tips: A 7 km wine tunnel inside the mountain, in Kvareli.

backups.name: Tsinandali Chavchavadze Estate
backups.tips: A princely manor and garden; an alternative to Telavi.

stops.name: Sololaki Courtyards
stops.tips: Art Nouveau entrances and wooden balconies, the Kalantarov house and the Betlemi stairs.

stops.name: Mother of Georgia Kartlis Deda
stops.tips: The aluminium Mother statue on Sololaki hill, holding wine and a sword.

stops.name: Mtatsminda Funicular & Pantheon
stops.tips: The funicular takes you up to 770 m. See the pantheon of Griboyedov and other writers, and St David's Church.

stops.name: Funicular Restaurant Mtatsminda
stops.tips: Lobiani and Acharuli khachapuri (boat-shaped), a city panorama and famous ponchiki.

stops.name: Vake Park & Turtle Lake
stops.tips: A park with a victory monument. Take the cable car to Turtle Lake and rent a boat.

backups.name: Ethnographic Museum Tbilisi
backups.tips: An open-air museum of Georgian houses next to Turtle Lake.

backups.name: Café Stamba
backups.tips: A stylish cafe in a Soviet printing house, in Vera.

days.theme: Dezerter Bazaar and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Dezerter Bazaar
stops.tips: A huge local market by the station: churchkhela, suluguni, tkemali and spices.

stops.name: Tsminda Sameba Cathedral
stops.tips: The Holy Trinity Cathedral (2004), 87 m tall with a golden dome, on Avlabari hill.

stops.name: Machakhela Avlabari
stops.tips: An Adjarian khachapuri chain; a farewell meal.

stops.name: Airport Bus 337 Freedom Square
stops.tips: Bus 337 takes 40 minutes (Metromoney), or take a Bolt for 30 GEL.

backups.name: Metekhi Church & Vakhtang Gorgasali
backups.tips: A church on a rock and a statue of the king; an alternative to the cathedral.

backups.name: Puri Guliani Bakery
backups.tips: Bread from a tone (clay oven) and lobiani, on the street.
